title: Funko seems to not care, Amazon is clueless. But the items are still exclusive and Pops!
text:
Funko is not listening to their fans, and they’ve basically washed their hands and say it’s all Amazon now. With regards to the huge debacle that was the Dagobah box, Amazon has no clue how the subscription works as evidenced by numerous posts regarding this. I reached out to Funko, and received the below response.

Funko Support (Funko)
Mar 4, 2:47 PM PST

Hi Richard,

I understand your frustration with the Amazon subscriptions. Unfortunately, we cannot assist with orders through Amazon, since they are an independent distributor. We know that Amazon's customer support encompasses the countless number of products they offer, so individual agents may not have in-depth knowledge of how their company processes these subscriptions.

If supplies are limited, that is a concern that Amazon must handle with their distributor contact or supply chain management, so it is disappointing to hear that they are pointing you to us, when we handle issues related to purchases made through the Funko Shop.

And while we do not have any insight into Amazon's system, our best guess is that next month's box is shown on Amazon's website, leading their customers to believe that they will not receive the current month's box, or that there is a delay in shipment. For example, a February box expected to ship in April or May.

For further support with your subscription account, we encourage you to reach back out to Amazon and see if they can put you in contact with a representative that has more insight into their Smugglers Bounty boxes.

Best regards,
Maca with Funko Support

Now...with regards to content, well...it has gone down. I’ve been a subscriber to Smugglers Bounty since it’s introduction when it was done directly by Funko. So I have tons of pins and patches, t-shirts or hats, even socks and wrist bands etc. The box quality has declined, we used to get art specific to the theme on the box, now it’s just not the same.

Specific to the “Dagobah” theme now: SPOILERS!

A movie moment...okay, these aren’t always popular, they’re large and hard to display. Especially if you have to look down to see them. I’m not usually disappointed in them, but I was this time mostly because we literally just got a movie moment from “Empire” when we got the Cloud City box. So to receive another movie moment was disappointing. The mystery mini HAD to be who it was or else we wouldn’t have gotten him at all. So many things they could’ve done with Yoda!

Overall the box isn’t the same as when Funko distributes the box themselves. We haven’t had a wearable since Amazon took over. I really wish Funko would listen/read the reviews and see what fans are missing and wanting. I personally love Star Wars, and I do enjoy having exclusive items you can’t find in stores. So I keep buying, but the dollar doesn’t always stretch as much as it used to.
label: neutral
